card.name: Small vertex sets meeting every maximal clique of three fixed random graphs

task.name: Small vertex sets meeting every maximal clique of three fixed random graphs
task.description: construct() -> three vertex lists, one per instance from random_graph(n, p, seed) for (30,0.3,201), (35,0.25,202), (40,0.2,203) in the verifier. Each list must meet every maximal clique with at least two vertices (all maximal cliques enumerated by Bron-Kerbosch). Minimize the total size. The score totals transversal sizes on three fixed random graphs; it measures a covering method.
